summary: Ming Shing Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held on June 16, 2026. Shareholders approved a share reorganization including increasing authorized share capital from USD 50,000 to USD 25,000,000, redesignating existing shares into Class A (1 vote each) and Class B (100 votes each) ordinary shares, and adopting amended articles. 57.23% of votes were represented; all resolutions passed overwhelmingly. This is a routine capital structure change with no acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation; it reflects governance reclassification to concentrate voting power.
